facts.fact: Internet Society Pulse, from PeeringDB data of August 2026, shows SIXP Sudan (Sudan Internet Exchange Point) with four members at 1 Gbps each, three using RPKI, and no ASN joined or left in the previous 12 months; city not given.
Internet Society Pulse lists two PCH autonomous systems (AS3856 and AS42), registered in the United States, among the four members of SIXP Sudan in August 2026, alongside Sudatel and Zain.
